provenance.author: PowerWorld authoring (procedural, img2threejs method)
provenance.terms: Committed procedural factory reviewed as build-time source. Proportions follow the engine's existing pistol so the primary grip mounts on the production hand socket; the full-extension support-hand fit remains an integration blocker.
provenance.attribution: Method: img2threejs (Apache-2.0) at the recorded revision; no img2threejs code ships in the package.

blockers.summary: In full-extension aim takes the production rig cannot close the support hand on the grip (measured 0.5-0.9 u gap; arm reach 3.58 u on a 3.92 u shoulder span at scale 1.12). Only the drawn-in reload pose closes within 0.35 u. The armed carrier must pull the trigger hand back before this weapon can be called fitted in aim poses.
